    Student Council (TUSC)

    Data

    CSV datasets from the Student Council, Tha Prachan, with a full data dictionary for the budget lines.

    Released
    31 October 2026
    Next release
    To be announced
    Contact
    TUSC secretariat team, Tha Prachan [shared address to be confirmed]

    On this page

    1. About the files
    2. Datasets

    About the files

    • CSV files are UTF-8 with a byte order mark, so Thai opens correctly in Excel.
    • One header row, ISO dates (year-month-day, Gregorian), numbers without separators, and no total rows.
    • Missing values are spelled out in square brackets, for example [not stated]. They are never blank, “-” or “NA”.

    Datasets

    • Members and roles

      • Dataset
      • Released 31 October 2026
      • Next release: to be announced
      • 149 rows

      Council members, their roles and bodies, with the source document and clause.

      Columns: person, person_latin, faculty, party, role, body, from, to, source_documents, source_reference

      • Members and roles (CSV, 53 KB)

      Used in: People, Committees

    • Committees

      • Dataset
      • Released 31 October 2026
      • Next release: to be announced
      • 11 rows

      The committees and offices, with remit, legal basis and dates of appointment.

      Columns: name, type, parent, remit, legal_basis, appointed_on, ended_on, members_as_appointed, chair, status, source_document

      • Committees (CSV, 6 KB)

      Used in: Committees

    • Meetings

      • Dataset
      • Released 31 October 2026
      • Next release: to be announced
      • 7 rows

      The meetings, with date, place, chair, members present, on leave and absent, and the date the minutes were adopted.

      Columns: session_type, session_number, meeting_number, meeting_th, date, place, chair, present, on_leave, absent, seats, minutes_adopted_on, minutes_document, agenda_document

      • Meetings (CSV, 2 KB)

      Used in: Meetings

    • Decisions

      • Released 31 October 2026

      Columns: decision_ref, meeting_date, meeting, item_printed, minutes_anchor, topic, type, decision_th, decision_en, votes_for, votes_against, votes_abstain, members_voting_printed, party_breakdown_printed, outcome, amount_thb

      • Decisions (CSV, 18 KB)

      Columns: fiscal_year_be, view, organisation_type, organisation, project, category, amount_thb, source_page

    • Recommendations

      • Dataset
      • Released 31 October 2026
      • Next release: to be announced

      Recommendations in the committee reports, with who they are addressed to and their status.

      • University funds (CSV, 52 KB)

      Used in: Funds

    • Canteen survey

      • Dataset
      • Released 31 October 2026

      Canteen problems and how many respondents mentioned each, from the committee report.

      Columns: problem_th, problem_en, mentions

      • Canteen survey (CSV, 1 KB)

      Used in: Reports

    Data dictionary: budget lines

    File
    budget-lines.csv (91 rows, 8 columns) (20 KB)
    Coverage
    FY 2569 (2026) (81 rows) and FY 2568 (2025) (10 rows)
    Source
    Report - Summary of Student Activity Budget Report, Fiscal Year 2026 (B.E. 2569) (source document 48, no date printed), pages 5 to 14 and 16
    Unit
    Baht, as printed on each page
    !

    Warning: This file holds three views of the same money. Do not add rows across views. Always filter the view column first.

    What the file covers

    • The Student Affairs Division has 200,000.00 baht in the organisation view only, with no project or category lines.
    • FY 2568 (2025) has the organisation view only, totalling 1,970,599.50 baht.
